test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of E. Only two people sit between D and C. G has no neighbours on the left. D is the only neighbour of A. B sits third to the right of G. Who sits third to the right of G?
solution: Given: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 1) Only two people sit to the right of E. 2) G has no neighbours on the left. 3) B sits third to the right of G.
